subject: ddl: fix OOM issue when adding many indexes (#60676)
summary: In add-index external-storage backfill, compute a per-writer adjusted membuf block size from the per-index memory quota and pass it into the external writer builder, preventing membuf alignment from inflating small quotas up to the 16MiB default and causing OOM when many index writers exist. Change is confined to buffering parameters (no DDL metadata/state-machine changes); reviewed external writer allocation path to confirm behavior remains correct.
